_: 宿題島. One house — しゅくだいの いえ — and the whole island points at it: walk in and the homework your teacher handed out opens. The questions are NOT here (they carry answers and live in DATA_DIR/homework.json on the server, put there from /admin/homework). Coordinates are relative to the island's own x/z, like every other island's JSON. Colours are decimals because island-kit.js reads them as numbers.
